description: This file defines an internal interface IInternalGrainFactory within the Orleans framework, providing methods for creating object references, retrieving system targets, and casting grains to specific interfaces. It is part of the core Orleans system implementation.

classes.name: IInternalGrainFactory
classes.description: An internal interface extending IGrainFactory, providing methods for creating object references, obtaining system target references, and casting grains.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a reference to the provided object implementing IAddressable.

methods.name: GetSystemTarget
methods.description: Retrieves a system target reference based on grain type and destination silo or grain ID.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts a grain to a specified interface or type.

overloads.returns: An object implementing the specified interface type.
